description: Evaluates Model Context Protocol (MCP) tool exposure, discoverability layer setup, and least-privilege guardrails

tasks.name: Design Model Context Protocol (MCP) server interface and discoverability
tasks.user_prompt: We are architecting our CLI tool to be directly callable by AI coding agents. How should we expose its core commands via Model Context Protocol (MCP) and structure root discoverability assets?

tasks.name: Enforce least-privilege guardrails and dry-run safety for agent actions
tasks.user_prompt: An autonomous agent has access to tools that can delete files or drop database tables. How should the system architecture enforce guardrails and least privilege?
